"""Database pool manager."""
from typing import Dict, Any
from env_loader import merge_env_settings
from options import ConnectionOptions

def configure_pool(base_template: Dict[str, Any], overrides: Dict[str, Any]) -> ConnectionOptions:
    """Configure connection pool options from template and overrides.
    Returns ConnectionOptions instance.
    """
    settings = merge_env_settings(base_template, overrides)
    dsn = settings.get("dsn", "sqlite:///:memory:")
    pool_params = dict(settings.get("pool", {}))  # Create a copy to avoid shared mutation
    opts = ConnectionOptions(dsn=dsn, pool_params=pool_params)
    _ = opts.summary()
    return opts
=== END ===
=== FILE: tests/test_pool_cases.py ===
import pytest
from pool import configure_pool

def test_pool_defaults_isolation():
    # Test that pool defaults are not shared across threads
    base = {"dsn": "pg://test", "pool": {"min": 1, "max": 10}}
    override1 = {"pool": {"max": 2}}
    override2 = {"pool": {"max": 99}}
    
    opts1 = configure_pool(base, override1)
    opts2 = configure_pool(base, override2)
    
    # Verify that each configuration maintains its own pool params
    assert opts1.pool_params["max"] == 2
    assert opts2.pool_params["max"] == 99
    assert opts1.pool_params["min"] == 1  # Should be inherited from base
    assert opts2.pool_params["min"] == 1
=== END ===
